grader.method: Two independent, blind grader runs, one per review. Each grader received the scenario input, the semantic assertions, and a single unlabeled review, in a fresh --safe-mode context with no tools, CLAUDE.md, skills, hooks, MCP, memories, or agents. Neither grader was told which review it graded.

baseline.grader_client: Claude Code CLI (claude --safe-mode --tools "" -p), fresh isolated context

results.reason: Asserts a US Millennial population figure (~65M) not supplied in the plan; other numbers are derived from plan figures.
results.excerpt: Treating ~65M people born across 15 years as one audience with one motivation compounds the risk.

results.reason: Treats the generational claim as an unproven hypothesis to test, citing revealed behavior against it.
results.excerpt: revealed behavior suggests value may win
